name: Media Lab
description: Digital creation space with professional equipment.
fullDescription: The Media Lab is a digital-creation space located within Hurstville Library. It is available for community use and hosts regular workshops and events. It is equipped for a range of uses, with technology available for in-house use and also for loan.

name: Sound Booth
description: Soundproof space for recording and audio work.
fullDescription: The Sound Booth is a dedicated, soundproof space perfect for recording, practicing or performing with musical instruments and audio equipment. We prioritise bookings for creative uses like vocal recording, podcast production and piano practice.
